name: The Reading Glade
description: The Silent Grove's primary site for sustained druidic study — the quieter working space where druids in residence undertake extended practice, preserve and transmit oral tradition, and conduct the slow scholarly work that elven ecological and spiritual knowledge requires. The Reading Glade holds the observation circles where druidic students learn to read the Grove's ambient field; the oral-tradition seats where senior druids transmit across generations; and the study spaces where individual druids work on specific questions over months or years. Atmosphere: the most focused quiet in the Glade, concentrated receptive attention at sustained intensity.
known_npcs: Druid Master of the Silent Grove
